title: Named code block spans
responsibility: Finds named top-level functions and class methods in masked JavaScript or TypeScript source.

inputs.name: blockSpans.masked
inputs.description: The JavaScript or TypeScript source text, already masked by the caller, because this function masks nothing itself and builds its brace and group nesting from this exact string. Every returned start and end is an index into this string, and declarations are recognized only where a line begins after optional spaces or tabs, so a declaration that follows other code on the same line is not reported.

outputs.name: blockSpans
outputs.description: Spans sorted by ascending start, each with a name, a kind, and start and end offsets into the input: a named top-level function, or a top-level const, let or var initialized with a function expression or arrow function, has kind 'function' under its own name, while a method of a named top-level class, or a class field of such a class initialized with a function expression or arrow function, has kind 'method' under the name Class.member. The class itself is not returned, each start is the offset of the declaration's first character after any leading spaces or tabs, and a declaration whose end cannot be found is omitted.
